facts.title: charred corn tacos with zucchini-radish slaw
ingredients: 1/2 pound red radishes (from about 2/3 of a bundle with stems and leaves), trimmed
1 small (4 to 5 ounces) zucchini, long and narrow if you can find it
1 tablespoon olive oil, plus additional if blistering tacos in skillet
3 tablespoons chopped epazote, cilantro or pasley (for the cilantro-averse) leaves (optional)
1/2 cup (2 1/2 ounces or 70 grams) crumbled cotija cheese (or another salty, crumbly cheese such as ricotta salata or feta)
facts.author: Deb Perelman
